rows.ARS: White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
rows.Bloom: White. Mild fragrance. Large, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped, quartered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Dedicated to Ing. Niso Fumagalli, founder of the Roseto di Monza.
Source: Catalogue of Rose Barni 2007/8
